The '''Kalarba pirates''' were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] crew that operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they successfully [[Death/Legends|eliminated]] [[Alinta]] and her assistants, while working for the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] and his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="WS" />
